label: Job-seeking benefit: daily floor at eight hours
appliesTo: Claimants whose relevant scheduled working day was eight hours — not part-timers
why: The floor is derived, not announced: hourly minimum wage x 8 hours x 80%. It moves every January with the minimum wage. A claimant on fewer scheduled hours has a different, lower floor, so this figure is not a universal minimum.

history.note: ₩10,320 x 8 x 80%. Follows the 2026 minimum wage, so it changes whenever that does.
